title: The Higgs mass ratio and self-coupling from the unique Fold ground
description:
Read the full mathematical paper (PDF)

An exact Higgs relation: m_H/v = 1/2 + (6/5)α and λ = (m_H/v)²/2.

Maria Smith derives the unique displaced half-One ground from the complete minimal Fold census and the self-antipodal equation. All six binary-hand by generator-direction cells participate. Holding the invariant return leaves five active cells, independently equal to the least binary cover depth of volume 27. One terminal alpha return therefore contributes exactly (6/5)α.

With the independently derived α = 3676744786/503846395469, the exact mass ratio is 2563352914777/5038463954690 and the exact coupling is approximately 0.129416752514. The original released scale 246.22 GeV gives 125.266104978… GeV inside the complete registered PDG interval [125.09, 125.31] GeV.

The paper includes the complete ground uniqueness argument, leading half/quarter/eighth rungs, all support counts, full electromagnetic input, intermediate mass and coupling algebra, 2,048-form classification and complete five-source comparison. Separate ATLAS and CMS offsets and the Higgs-pair constraint are retained with the original values.

Native Lean 4 proofs and complete source-output records accompany the paper. The formal audit contains 165 declarations and the empirical audit 117, both with zero axiom dependencies. Original pinned V3 code, imported proof dependencies and exact arithmetic are included in the evidence archive.
